        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MoveToAdmin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Flow nodes -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Start mortgage offer process" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendOffer" name="Send Mortgage offer to the customer" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitReply" name="Wait for reply" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReplyType" name="Customer reply type?" />

    <!-- Decline path -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateDetails_Decline" name="Update case details" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Archive_Decline" name="Archive case prior to cancellation" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Decline" name="Case cancelled (decline)" />

    <!-- Provide documents path -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DocCheck" name="All prerequisite documents provided?" />

    <!-- Yes – move to administration -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MoveToAdmin" name="Move case to administration for completion" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Admin" name="Case handed to administration" />

    <!-- No – request missing documents -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestDocs" name="Generate message requesting outstanding documents" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_Wait2Weeks" name="Wait 2 weeks for answer">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration>PT336H</bpmn:timeDuration> <!-- 2 weeks -->
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateDetails_NoAnswer" name="Update case details" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Archive_NoAnswer" name="Archive case prior to cancellation" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoAnswer" name="Case cancelled (no answer)" />

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_SendOffer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_WaitReply" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_WaitReply" targetRef="Gateway_ReplyType" />

    <!-- Decline branch -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" name="decline" sourceRef="Gateway_ReplyType" targetRef="Task_UpdateDetails_Decline" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_UpdateDetails_Decline" targetRef="Task_Archive_Decline" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Archive_Decline" targetRef="End_Decline" />

    <!-- Documents provided branch -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" name="documents provided" sourceRef="Gateway_ReplyType" targetRef="Gateway_DocCheck" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_DocCheck" targetRef="Task_MoveToAdmin" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_MoveToAdmin" targetRef="End_Admin" />

    <!-- Missing documents branch -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_DocCheck" targetRef="Task_RequestDocs" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_RequestDocs" targetRef="Timer_Wait2Weeks" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Timer_Wait2Weeks" targetRef="Task_UpdateDetails_NoAnswer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_UpdateDetails_NoAnswer" targetRef="Task_Archive_NoAnswer" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_Archive_NoAnswer" targetRef="End_NoAnswer" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
